memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine review of atrial fibrillation, IBS and diabetes.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She reports occasional palpitations, mild bloating and intermittent loose stools. No chest pain or dyspnea.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 58 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 24.1 (overweight). Pulse irregularly irregular at 78 bpm. Abdomen soft, no tenderness.
IMPRESSION: Atrial fibrillation on apixaban and warfarin with INR in range. IBS symptoms mild. Diabetes suboptimal with HbA1c 7.2%.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds, check INR in 2 weeks, repeat HbA1c in 3 months. Advise reduced refined carbs and daily 30‑min walk. Return if palpitations worsen, black stools, fever >39°C, or sudden abdominal pain.

memories.text: ECG: Irregularly irregular rhythm with absent P waves, consistent with atrial fibrillation. Ventricular rate 78 bpm. No acute ST‑T changes.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: "I feel occasional palpitations and my bowel movements are irregular; sometimes I have loose stools after meals."

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: 3‑month follow‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Palpitations less frequent, bloating improved, occasional diarrhoea after heavy meals.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 57.5 kg, BMI 23.9 (overweight). Pulse irregularly irregular 76 bpm. Lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: AF rate controlled. IBS better with current regimen. Diabetes: HbA1c 6.8% (improved).
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase bisoprolol to 5 mg OD for better rate control. Continue other meds. Review INR in 1 week. Return if syncopal episodes, worsening diarrhoea with blood, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: scheduled review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No new cardiac symptoms, occasional mild abdominal discomfort after lentils.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/80 mmHg, weight 57 kg, BMI 23.7 (overweight). Pulse irregularly irregular 74 bpm.
IMPRESSION: AF stable on apixaban+warfarin. IBS controlled. Diabetes: HbA1c 6.6%.
ARRANGEMENTS: Add sitagliptin 100 mg OD (already on board) – continue. Order fasting lipid profile and TSH. Advise low‑fat diet and maintain activity. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, melena, or vomiting.

memories.author: D03

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: post‑cardiology review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No palpitations, bowel habits regular, occasional mild epigastric discomfort after spicy food.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/78 mmHg, weight 56.5 kg, BMI 23.5 (overweight). Pulse irregularly irregular 72 bpm.
IMPRESSION: AF on apixaban only, rate controlled. IBS mild. Diabetes: HbA1c 6.5%.
ARRANGEMENTS: Stop warfarin. Continue apixaban, bisoprolol, mebeverine, ispaghula husk, metformin, glimepiride, sitagliptin, empagliflozin. Repeat INR not needed. Return if sudden weakness, speech change, severe abdominal pain, or fever >39°C.
